pr_title: ESQL: Graceful handling of non-bool condition in the filter
pr_body:
Improve the Verifier to handle queries with non-boolean expressions
 used in the WHERE clause (where 10)
In the process improve the readability of the Verifier class by
 extracting the checks into their own methods

Fix #100049
Fix #100409

issue_context.body:
### Elasticsearch Version

8.11.0

### Installed Plugins

_No response_

### OS Version

### Problem Description

I would expect a clear message for the following ES|QL query:

```
from index | where 1 year
```

But what I get is:

```
[esql] > Unexpected error from Elasticsearch: illegal_argument_exception - Unrecognized class type class java.time.Period
```

See above.
